D.name: The Luna Sauna
D.intro: A modern cedar cube with soft, rounded corners and a full glass front. Three sizes seat four to six, with room for a wood-burning stove or an electric heater.
specs: Two large windows (3 mm tempered double-pane) and a 5 mm tempered glass door, each about 22¾" wide
Premium grade western red cedar, clear or knotty, single-stave bevels
Fully enclosed two-tier benches; side-wall or L-bench layouts available
Level and solid: concrete pad, wood deck, patio stone or crushed stone
240V, 30–50 amp depending on the heater; final hookup by a licensed electrician
7.5 kW electric or wood-burning, sized for this room

about.title: Soft corners, modern lines
about.lede: The Luna pairs rounded cedar corners with a big glass front for a sauna that looks at home in any yard.
items: Curved cedar corners and a flat EPDM roof give it a clean, modern profile.
Two large windows and a glass door fill the room with light. Choose bronze or mirrored glass, or skip the windows for privacy.
Two back-wall benches come standard; side-wall benches or a back wall with an L-bench are available.
Fire it with a wood stove or a 240V electric heater. Handcrafted in Canada from western red cedar.
